messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — vendor retest confirmed for Wed morning. We need a short-lived privilege window for the assessor, an evidence bucket, and an audit-export snapshot.
aj: Thanks. Can we limit the assessor role to read-only for S3 + CloudTrail logs? No write perms.
maria: Yes, goal is read-only. Also need a KMS decrypt proxy for any encrypted artifacts. Prefer scoped KMS grant instead of sharing customer keys.
cheng: For KMS, we can create a grant with a -> "Decrypt" operation and a 6-hour TTL. We have a small script to revoke after window. ping me for the ARN.
samir: On S3: suggest a dedicated prefix in the evidence-bucket: `pen-tests/assessor-2025-06-18/` with MFA delete off for the short window. We'll presign GET links and collect hashes.
kate: How are we handling audit logs? We should export a CloudTrail snapshot to a separate read-only bucket and snapshot the last 7 days of events.
maria: Exactly. Also want an integrity checksum file (sha256) uploaded by ops-oncall after packaging.
ops-oncall: I can run the export and upload. Proposed timeline: open window 08:00-14:00 UTC, export at 07:50, revoke grants at 14:10.
aj: Sounds good. Add me and cheng as approvers; I'll approve in Slack when you post the temporary role.
security-bot: Reminder: Create ephemeral IAM role named `pt-assessor-ephemeral-<ts>` and annotate ticket #SEC-457 for audit.
maria: Minimal access list we agreed on: S3:GetObject, S3:ListBucket (prefix-limited), KMS:Decrypt via grant, CloudTrail:LookupEvents, Logs:Read. No console access.
cheng: For evidence transfer, I'll hand over an upload script. Example presign command we use: ```aws s3 presign s3://evidence-bucket/pen-tests/assessor-2025-06-18/trace.tar.gz --expires-in 86400``` use 1d presign for individual files.
samir: Note: presigned downloads + sha256 manifest. Ops will verify manifests before handing to vendor.
kate: Also we need retention note: vendor will have downloads available for 72 hours, after which we delete the prefix. Put this in the scope doc.
maria: Who will be the on-call contact during the window? ops-oncall will run revoke and help troubleshoot.
ops-oncall: I'll be available. Slack pings + pager as fallback. If anything looks off, we stop access immediately and snapshot logs.
aj: Small ask — can we make CloudTrail export immutable for the snapshot period? S3 object lock with governance mode for 24h might help.
cheng: We can enable governance-mode on the snapshot bucket for 24h. Need a support ticket to ops if we don't already have object lock enabled on that bucket.
samir: I'll create the prefix, set ACLs, and pre-create a KMS grant. CHENG — share the grant ARN.
cheng: Will DM the grant ARN and the command to revoke: ```aws kms retire-grant --grant-id <id> --key-id <key>```
maria: Great. After retest, we'll do a quick triage call at 1600 UTC same day to agree on remediation tickets.
kate: I'll create the remediation epics and assign severity tags based on vendor findings.
maria: Thanks team. I'll post final checklist + approval once KMS grant and S3 prefix are ready. @aj @cheng please ACK when done. :thumbsup:
